findings.text: reviewer failed to run: fetch failed

The Baseline column draws the first truth.jsonl line, which the readme itself calls wrong ("the first baseline line wrongly counted only records with a log"), so today is compared against bad numbers (Requirements 4). Cause: `page.js` `first = runs[0]`. Pick the newest line labelled baseline (or a `baseline: true` flag), or move the bad line aside.

Three Baseline cells print `undefined` ("with a task log", "tag-only record", "transcript only"): the first line used `with_record`, not these fields — shots/…/1200.png middle band, 400.png bottom band.

The table is clipped at its right edge at every width, silently (layout.json `overflow_x false`): at 1200 "Counted by" is cut mid-word ("SessionFolders.homes", "log_file"); at 400 "Baseline, all" shows "undefine…" and "Counted by" is off screen (sizing, wrapping). Move the "Counted by" notes out of the table (a footnote or a title) so four number columns fit at 400.

The daily line is never committed: `TaskLoop.truth_daily()` appends to `public/live/truth/truth.jsonl` in the main tree, but `Servex/LogSweeper.js` `ALLOW` has no pattern for it (handover.md, written the same way, has one). The trend lives only on this disk; the repo is the source of truth (Law 5).

Deliverable 5 is undocumented: the page and readme say "the 1,410 twins were folded before the first run", but no fold commit or manifest is in git (`git log --all --since=2026-11-01` shows none), and `one-folder.md` still says "Today (2026-11-01): 1,408 sessions are held twice … can be folded". Link the run and its manifest, or correct the claim, and update that stale line. `--check` on the main tree does say "ok: every session has one folder" today.
`Server/Truth.mjs` and `Server/Truth.test.mjs` are not in `Server/readme.md`, which lists every Server script (it has `SessionConsolidate.mjs`). Unindexed (Law 10).

The truth page is linked from no AI doc: not `public/framework/ai/readme.md`, `sessions/readme.md` or `handover.md` — only `/live/`'s auto-built list and two doc lines (one-folder.md, task-loop.md). It is the page about the session record; the AI readme should name it.

`measure()` calls `store.adopt_nested()`, which `claim()`s and saves the SessionFolders map, so a "read-only" `--root <other tree>` run and the daily job write state. Make it read-only, or say so in the header.

A fresh agent cannot continue from this task folder: it holds the brief, past-work and the review, but no task log or note of what landed (baseline commit, the corrected line, the twin status) or what is left; the work sits on branch `worktree/truth-truth-page`, named nowhere in the folder.
The page throws on every width: layout.json `errors` lists a 404 and "TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'title')" at 400, 1200, 1920 and 3440.

The intro repeats itself ("Baseline (baseline, before the truth-job fixes merge…) was measured before the fixes of the truth job merged") and numbers have no thousands separators (11862, 12991, beside the brief's 1,410) — content.
The headline "0" sits on its own baseline and its sentence wraps so "must be 0" / "0" lands alone on a line — 1200.png and 400.png, band 2.

Only one sum is checked by the script (with_tasks + no_tasks = sessions); the readme claims with_log + tag_only + transcript_only = sessions too, but nothing refuses a line where it fails. `needs_review` always equals `no_tasks`.
Colours are hard-coded (`#4a8`, `#8884` in truth.css), not tokens; the trend bar height (`share × 100 × 8` px) overflows its 9em box above about 18%.
`TruthLog` is a new class with no page showing its live instance; it only holds the file's lines, which the page already draws.
